2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the seventh respondent runs Alnaseeb Automatic Bakery and Arabian Delights Restaurant in a residential area, primarily dealing in meat and non- vegetarian food, without maintaining proper hygiene and causing severe nuisance to residents.

sentences.text: The seventh respondent is operating the unit without requisite statutory licenses, violating environmental laws.
Additionally, the seventh respondent is allegedly storing large quantities of diesel illegally, without safety measures, posing a serious threat to the nearby residents.
Despite several representations to the authorities and complaints to the Government and RTI responses, no action has been taken, compelling the petitioner to file the present writ petition.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 30/04/2025 11:36:08 am )

3. Learned counsel appearing for the first respondent submitted that this Court may direct the seventh respondent to give a fresh application for trade license to run a bakery and restaurant,
before the first respondent within a time frame to fixed by this Court.

4. Heard the learned counsel on either side and perused the materials available on record.
5.

Considering the submission made by the learned counsel on either side, this Court without going into the merits of the case, issues the following directions:
(i) The seventh respondent is directed to give a fresh application for trade license to run a bakery and restaurant, before the first respondent along with relevant documents including No-Objection Certificate obtained from the concerned authorities viz., Fire Department and FSSAI within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order;
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 30/04/2025 11:36:08 am )
(ii) On such receipt, the first respondent is directed to consider the said application by conducting detailed enquiry, after giving due notice to the petitioner as well as the seventh respondent,
opportunity of personal hearing and considering the documents filed by both the parties on merits,
in accordance with law and pass appropriate orders within a period of eight weeks thereof.
6. This writ petition is disposed of with the aforesaid observation and directions.
No costs.
